chains.Q1_hollow: Ability to know if this breath is enough — chest-check loop in the dark
chains.Q2_villain: Blind hospital bulb that returns noise and hope, never a visible answer
chains.Q3_dream: Standing by the crib not counting — just there
chains.Q5_arc: Ready parent → night watchman → saline/steam/bulb fail to prove → twist: working blind → cup shows leave
chains.Q6_fit: Clear collection cup makes mucus visible when it leaves
chains.Q7_core: Night sounds don't just wake you — they steal the ability to know what's true.
Q8_headlines: I pressed my ear to his chest and learned nothing.
His chest rose and I still had no answer.
Checking his chest all night proved I was blind.
chains.headline_picked: I pressed my ear to his chest and learned nothing.

chains.Q1_hollow: Help exists but cannot be handed over; isolation inside the couple
chains.Q2_villain: Mouth-suction tube that demands one parent's mouth
chains.Q3_dream: Passing the device without a speech and without that knot
chains.Q5_arc: He offered → I refused → disgust not character → twist: tool decided who could help → no-mouth cup
chains.Q6_fit: Clear cup without mouth contact makes handoff possible
chains.Q7_core: When the tool needs someone's mouth, help stops being shareable.
Q8_headlines: Mouth suction made help a job only I would take.
I said no when he offered the tube.
The mouth tube kept the night on one parent.
chains.headline_picked: Mouth suction made help a job only I would take.

chains.Q1_hollow: Care ritual may have been contamination; gut-level betrayal
chains.Q2_villain: Sealed rubber bulb you cannot see, clean, or dry inside
chains.Q3_dream: Open pieces on the counter; nothing left to imagine growing in the dark
chains.Q5_arc: Nurse handed the bulb → obeyed → smell/thought of the chamber → twist: helper hid → see-and-wash cup
chains.Q6_fit: Clear cleanable cup has no hidden chamber
chains.Q7_core: The tool you trusted to protect them may be the thing you should have feared.
Q8_headlines: The bulb I trusted hid a smell I couldn't unsee.
I couldn't wash the inside of the hospital bulb.
A sealed bulb kept what I would never put in her nose.
chains.headline_picked: I couldn't wash the inside of the hospital bulb.

chains.Q1_hollow: Effort without feedback; still 'nothing comes out'
chains.Q2_villain: Opaque weak clear-outs (bulb / same idea in new boxes) that reward sunk shopping
chains.Q3_dream: The unused extras stay in the drawer; no fourth box in the line
chains.Q5_arc: Bulb then tube then electric → still blind → twist: more force wasn't the plan → need proof
chains.Q6_fit: Visible collection is the feedback loop
chains.Q7_core: Trying harder with tools that show you nothing is not a plan.
Q8_headlines: Three tubes later I was still guessing in the dark.
I kept buying blind tools that showed me nothing.
Nothing comes out was the only result I ever got.
chains.headline_picked: I kept buying blind tools that showed me nothing.

chains.Q1_hollow: Partnership replaced by night logistics / rota
chains.Q2_villain: Hospital bulb then mouth tube failing in the same night so neither adult can clock out
chains.Q3_dream: Same kitchen, shared quiet, a night that ends because the nose actually cleared
chains.Q5_arc: Team → rota → blamed the shifts → twist: unfinished blockage → visible finish
chains.Q6_fit: Finished visible clear lets the household clock out together
chains.Q7_core: When neither of you sleeps, you lose the partnership before you notice.
Q8_headlines: Nights turned us into a rota instead of a couple.
Congestion made us two tired shift workers.
We stopped talking except to hand off the next watch.
chains.headline_picked: Nights turned us into a rota instead of a couple.

chains.Q1_hollow: Protection and self-hatred arrive together during the scream
chains.Q2_villain: Hospital bulb squeezed through her scream with no proof it helped
chains.Q3_dream: Her body goes heavy on your chest; you aren't narrating cruelty
chains.Q5_arc: Wanted to protect → felt cruel → twist: guilt aimed at me belonged to a method with no sight → visible care
chains.Q6_fit: Seeing the clear-out relocates blame off the parent
chains.Q7_core: Feeling like a monster while helping means the ritual is wrong — not that you are.
Q8_headlines: Clearing her nose made me feel like I was hurting her.
I feel so mean every time I finish a clear-out.
Helping her breathe sounded like I was the problem.
chains.headline_picked: Clearing her nose made me feel like I was hurting her.

chains.Q1_hollow: Competence collapses into guessing; ambiguity worse than a hard truth
chains.Q2_villain: The sealed guess dispenser — noise without an answer
chains.Q3_dream: The last advice screenshot stays unopened on the lock screen
chains.Q5_arc: Tried to be capable → bulb gave noise → twist: needed sight not slogans → cup is the answer layer
chains.Q7_core: You cannot be a capable parent in the dark if the tool never shows what happened.
Q8_headlines: Advice stacked up and none of it showed me the blockage.
Without seeing anything I stopped trusting my hands.
The bulb gave noise. Never an answer.
chains.headline_picked: Advice stacked up and none of it showed me the blockage.

chains.Q1_hollow: Tonight's exhaustion projected onto forever; only 'mum' left
chains.Q2_villain: Just-cope 'this is just the newborn stage' covering a hospital bulb that never shows a finish
chains.Q3_dream: Catching your face in morning glass — ordinary recognition, not inventory
chains.Q5_arc: Used to power down → 2am scans → thought this was who I became → twist: unfinished blockage not personality → visible end
chains.Q6_fit: A night that can end visibly is a door back to self
chains.Q7_core: Endless ON nights make a temporary crisis feel like your new personality.
Q8_headlines: 2am clearing left no version of me by morning.
I stopped recognizing the person under mum.
Morning glass showed a stranger I didn't schedule.
chains.headline_picked: 2am clearing left no version of me by morning.
